name: The Misadventures of Magical Girl Luna
detailed_description:
《The Misadventures of Magical Girl Luna》 is an RPG that emphasizes both combat and story.

Story

Welcome to a world where magic and technology exist side by side.

Luna, raised under the loving yet strict guidance of the great magician Sol, has grown into a capable magical girl (!?).

With her innocent and romantic outlook, Luna sets off on an unbelievable adventure,

facing all kinds of challenges along the way—

Her journey starts now!

Character

Trained by Sol with both love and discipline, Luna’s now a skilled magical girl.

She may look small, but don’t let her size fool you—she’s got strength that rivals adults!

She’s the type to charge ahead without much thinking.

[Sol: "Being energetic is great… but if she could think things through a bit more, that’d be even better."]

Gameplay

◆Battles

Special Battle Dialogues!

Immerse yourself in the story as you battle!

Discover enemies’ weaknesses and gain deeper insight into their personalities mid-fight!

[Sol: "The best way to beat an enemy is to understand them first."]

◆Post-Battle Tips

If Luna loses, Sol will step in with advice and strategies to help you win next time!

[Sol:" Don’t give up if you fail—failure is the stepping stone to success. I believe in you, Luna!"]

Game Features

◆Battle

Even if you lose, you can collect exclusive stamps!

After clearing the game, you can unlock bonus illustrations and other content. Explore everywhere for surprises!

[Sol: "After clearing the game, take some time to roam around. You might find something cool!"]

◆Collectibles

Everything on the map (not just shiny objects!) can be investigated!

You might stumble upon something valuable… or unusual!

[Sol: "While she loves picking up random things… sometimes they turn out to be surprisingly useful."]

◆Items

Anything Luna picks up along the way (yes, anything) can become a weapon!

Each item has unique effects.

You can use them directly or throw them at enemies for special results!

[Sol: "Well… it’s kind of her thing, but hey, it works!"]

◆Casino

Test Your Luck: “What’s life without a little risk?”

Race Against Time: “Is me, little Luna~⭐”

Chase Enemies: "Ora ora ora!"

No matter your playstyle, the casino’s got something for everyone.

Aim for the ultimate reward: the Platinum Star!

And rumor has it, Platinum-level players get access to a hidden secret…

[Sol: "Wait, when did she even go there…?"]

content_descriptors.notes:
This game may contain content unsuitable for all ages or viewing in the workplace:

- Some characters wear revealing outfits, such as angels, succubi, and other races dressed in swimsuit-like or minimalistic tight-fitting clothing.
- Mild depictions of violence.
- Characters with appearances resembling hanging (without any related suicide references).
